### Danish Legislative Speech Corpus

::: {.meta}
1.9 million snippets · 1997–2026 · Harvard Dataverse
:::

Data set containing 1.9 million snippets of Danish legislative speech. Covers the
universe of Danish legislative speech, 1997–2026. Version 3 of September 2026
extends the data coverage through 3 September 2026. Earlier versions are retained
on Dataverse for archival purposes; most users will want the newest version,
`paradf-v3.rds`.

Please cite as: Hjorth, Frederik, 2026, "Danish Legislative Speech Corpus V3",
Harvard Dataverse. URL: <https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PNCBKF>

[Link to data](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.7910/DVN/PNCBKF)
